Ms. Ameriya possesses expertise in corporate laws, corporate governance, and SEBI regulations, and is not related to any Director or KMP of the company.

Source: BSE

news.headline:
Jeena Sikho Lifecare Limited has received accreditation from the National Accreditation Board for Hospitals & Healthcare Providers (NABH) for its hospital located in Raipur, Chhattisgarh.

The NABH accreditation covers Panchakarma services under Certificate No. AH-2026-0513 and remains valid until August 20, 2029, signifying adherence to quality healthcare and patient safety standards.

Source: BSE
